    | exact exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (p := 2) h2_dvd

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem exists_proper_nontrivial_normal_subgroup_of_bounded_double_order {G : Type*} [Fintype G] [CommGroup G] {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 10) (hG : Fintype.card G = 2 * n) : ∃ H : Subgroup G, H.Normal ∧ H ≠ ⊥ ∧ H ≠ ⊤ := by
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 2) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have h2_dvd : 2 ∣ Fintype.card G := ⟨n, hG⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := G) (p := 2) h2_dvd
  let H : Subgroup G := Subgroup.zpowers g
  have hg2 : orderOf g = 2 := hg
  have hCardH_nat : Nat.card H = 2 := by
    have h1 : Nat.card H = orderOf g := Nat.card_zpowers g
    rw [h1, hg2]
  have hg_ne_one : g ≠ (1 : G) := by
    intro h
    have h1 : orderOf g = 1 := orderOf_eq_one_iff.mpr h
    rw [h1] at hg2
    contradiction
  have hNormal : H.Normal := by
    constructor
    intro n hn g'
    have hconj : g' * n * g'⁻¹ = n := by
      calc g' * n * g'⁻¹ = n * g' * g'⁻¹ := by rw [mul_comm g' n]
        _ = n * (g' * g'⁻¹) := by rw [mul_assoc]
        _ = n * 1 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel]
        _ = n := by rw [mul_one]
    rw [hconj]
    exact hn
  have hBot : H ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h_eq
    have hg_mem : g ∈ H := Subgroup.mem_zpowers g
    have hg_in_bot : g ∈ (⊥ : Subgroup G) := h_eq ▸ hg_mem
    rw [Subgroup.mem_bot] at hg_in_bot
    exact hg_ne_one hg_in_bot
  have hTop : H ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h_eq
    have hCardG_nat : Nat.card G = 2 * n := by rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hG]
    have hCardTop : Nat.card (⊤ : Subgroup G) = Nat.card G :=
      Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv Subgroup.mem_top)
    have h_eq_card : Nat.card H = Nat.card G := by rw [h_eq, hCardTop]
    rw [hCardH_nat, hCardG_nat] at h_eq_card
    omega
  exact ⟨H, hNormal, hBot, hTop⟩
